meta.source: Merged from 9 chunk6 files + 2 gap-fill builds (Jayce, Sona)

meta.v0_7_note: Legacy runtime wr_builds preserved; v0.7 generated strategy candidates appended with source_status fields.

builds.playstyle: Anti-AP burst. Maw magic shield + DD bleed + Mercury Treads tenacity. Survive burst then out-sustain.
Maximize armor shred. Q multi-hits apply Cleaver stacks rapidly. Anti-heal with Chempunk. Focus tanks.
Land Q sweetspots for healing. R amplifies healing by 30%. DD bleed keeps you alive. Conqueror stacks in Q combo for omnivamp. Front-to-back team fighting.
Max CDR. Soulstealer resets on takedowns. Cosmic Drive MS. Near-permanent R uptime.
Crown + Bone Plating + Barrier = triple anti-burst. Survive assassin all-in then counter.
E charm into Q+W+Electrocute burst. R repositioning or aggressive Flash+E picks. Roam post-6.
Extended fights. Conqueror + Riftmaker true damage. Nashor on-hit. Drain tank in shroud.
Q+AA passive + Lich Bane = burst. E+R for gap close. W shroud safety. Roam post-6.
E swing AAs with BotRK on-hit. LT stacking. Passive revive mechanic. W camouflage roam.
W+Q instant knockup. Hexflash from brush. R massive damage reduction. Flash+W+Q = game-winning.
Passive dash after abilities + empowered AAs. R suppress slam. Trinity Spellblade on AA weaving.
Flash+R AoE root. W burn + Sunfire. Abyssal MR shred for team. THE team fight tank.
Flash+R Tibbers AoE stun + burst. Point-click Q stun counters assassins. Simple but devastating.
Perma-slow. Q rapid-fire. R global stun. Utility ADC with consistent damage.
Farm Stardust. RoA + Stardust = double scaling. At 75 Stardust R becomes massive AoE. Late-game monster.
R creates zone enemies cannot leave. W hop untargetable. Q mark + detonate. Passive empowered attacks from brush/R. Zone trap mage.
Collect chimes for MS+mana+meep upgrades. Q double stun. W heal shrines. E portal through walls. R global AoE stasis. THE roaming support.
Q Rocket Grab hook pulls enemy. E knockup AA. R AoE silence. One hook wins games. Hexflash from brush for angles.
Rylai perma-slow on passive burn. R bounces in grouped fights. Passive %HP explosion. Highest damage support.
Passive 4 stacks = stun. E Unbreakable blocks ALL projectiles. W dash to ally + resists. R Glacial Fissure knockup. Guardian shield. THE peel tank.
Longest base AA range. Headshot passive crits. W traps for zone control + root. E net dash. R long-range snipe. Energized poke.
E hookshot leap stun. Q2 true damage + Trinity Spellblade. R lockdown. Trinity + Sterak core.
Passive 80% magic damage AAs. R missile poke (3rd = Big One). Package W long-range engage. E armor/MR shred. Mixed damage = hard to itemize against.
Ghost for 5 bleed stacks. Noxian Might massive AD. R true damage execute resets on kill. THE pentakill machine.
Q mark then E dash reset. Flash+R AoE pull. Best AoE burst jungler. Team fight around objectives.
Passive CC immunity. Q %HP cleaver poke. E bonus AD from HP. R heal massive %max HP. Heartsteel + Grasp = triple HP stacking. Warmog regen. Unkillable.
Catch Spinning Axes. Cash Adoration on kills. BT lifesteal + IE crit = one-shot AAs. THE lane bully.
E blink + Lich Bane AA. Passive 3-hit proc MS+damage. W stun zone. R Chronobreak rewind to safety + heal + AoE damage. Safe assassin with R escape.
Passive permanent stealth after level 5. W charm on full charge. E empowered dash. R Last Caress execute + blink back. DH stacking on low targets. THE stealth assassin.
Q poke with Muramana + Trinity Spellblade. Serylda slow for kiting. E blink safety. THE safest ADC.
R Crowstorm from fog = fear passive + massive AoE. Soulstealer = ult every fight. Q fear. W drain heal. E silence. THE surprise team fight ult.
Q to vitals for %HP true damage. W parry. R marks 4 vitals = healing zone. Hullbreaker + Demolish. THE duelist.
R shark knockup. Q+W+Lich Bane = instant delete. E untargetable. One-shot squishies at 2 items.
Flash+W taunt AoE. E dash knockup. R Hero's Entrance global dash to ally + AoE knockup. Anti-AP with W magic shield. Pick vs 3+ AP teams.
Q silence + E spin. Grasp short trades + passive regen. Dead Man MS + Q MS = fast engage. R execute.
Mini Gnar ranged poke + W %HP. Mega Gnar R throw into wall = AoE stun. Flash+R into terrain = game-winning. Manage Rage bar for team fights.
E stun + W %HP AA + Iceborn slow zone. R Explosive Cask knockback to isolate or disengage. Passive HP regen on ability use. Q barrel poke.
Shotgun AAs (blocked by first target). E dash + reload + armor stacking. W smoke screen. R Collateral Damage line nuke. Bruiser-assassin hybrid jungle.
E AS boost into AA stacking then Q center true damage. W Mist untargetable from outside. Riftmaker true damage + Conqueror omnivamp. R 3-cast needles.
E charge + passive MS-to-AD. Q spam Conqueror stacks. R fear engage. Trinity Spellblade on Q.
3 turrets zone control. Rylai slow on turret shots = perma-slow. R+Q mega turret. R+E mega stun. Siege and zone denial.
Q resets on marked/killed. E stun marks. BotRK + Wit's End double on-hit. Surf minion wave with Q.
E shield + AD buff + Aery. Q tornado knockup. W slow poke. R Monsoon knockback + AoE heal. THE disengage enchanter.
EQ flag+lance knockup. R Cataclysm impassable terrain arena. Passive %HP first-hit. Flash+R trap into EQ. AoE CC jungle engage.
Passive AS stacking + W reset + Trinity Spellblade. E dodges AAs then stuns. R bonus resists. Late-game 1v1 monster.

Ranged Q+E Shock Blast poke. Cannon form for ranged poke, Hammer form for melee burst. W Hyper Charge rapid AAs in cannon. Hammer Q+E combo for burst. Transform stance switching. Muramana + Aery poke. Strong early, scales with pen.
4th shot crits + %missing HP. AS to AD conversion. Energized + 4th shot poke. R Curtain Call global snipe.
Hurricane + Fishbones AoE = team-wiping DPS. Passive resets on kills. R global execute. THE hypercarry.
R transforms: tank resists become AD for dueling. Q3 knockup. W channel damage reduction. E dash. Most complex tank. R isolates target in 1v1.
Evolve Q at 70 AD. E stealth evolved. R dive to marked targets. BotRK + Plasma %HP shred.
Passive AA dashes. E Rend rip spears for burst (reset on kill). R Fate's Call pulls Oathsworn for knockup engage. Most mechanical ADC.
Aery Q poke + E shield. R+E team shield. Ardent + Staff double buff. Passive reduces R CD.
Fleet sustain pre-6. RoA + Archangel mana scaling. R stacks for burst. THE late-game assassin.
Q dagger + E shunpo. R Death Lotus AoE. Takedowns reset E. Conqueror stacks in R. Chain resets.
Melee early, ranged at level ups. Passive upgrades form. Nashor on-hit + waves. R invulnerability ult. Farm safely early then dominate late.
Rhaast: abilities heal. Q knockup. R heals %max HP. Conqueror + Rhaast = unkillable drain tank.
Shadow form: bonus magic damage on first hit. E through walls. R untargetable inside enemy. Full lethality one-shot.
Flash+R Slicing Maelstrom AoE stun in team fights. Ranged poke in baron lane vs melee. E lightning rush for engage/escape. Mark of the Storm 3 stacks = stun.
Isolated Q massive damage. Evolved Q range. E leap reset on kills. R stealth. THE isolation predator.
Passive marks grant bonus range + %HP damage. Q dash in W zone. E slow + burst. R Lamb's Respite = zone where nobody can die. Ranged jungle carry.
W Bio-Arcane Barrage = bonus range + %HP magic damage on-hit. LT + Guinsoo double proc + BotRK + Wit's End = maximum on-hit DPS. Needs peel (Lulu, Braum). THE highest DPS ADC.
Q dash. W ward-hop. E slow. R insec kick. Early invade pressure. Falls off but R always impactful.
E+Q+R triple CC. Ice Overlord freeze zones. Hexflash from brush. THE engage support.
Passive stacking MS from abilities. Q outer edge bonus damage. W AoE. E long-range seed. R Lilting Lullaby = sleep ALL dream-marked enemies. Riftmaker drain + Rylai perma-slow. Speed demon.
E claw for long-range engage. W root. Q poke. R self-cast = stasis + AoE damage OR target-cast = stun enemy. Counter vs assassins (R self when dove).
Passive double-shot after ability. ER Spellblade + passive. Navori crit resets CDs. Early lane bully.
E+Aery double shield. W polymorph. R Wild Growth knockup+HP. Ardent+Staff every shield. THE protect-the-carry.
Q root + E slow zone + R Final Spark laser = long-range burst combo. W shield allies. Comet + Q root guarantees hit. Safe poke mage. Works mid or support.
Flash+R Unstoppable Force = unavoidable AoE knockup engage. Passive shield. Q poke slow. W AA cleave. E AS slow aura. THE anti-AD engage tank. One R wins team fights.
R Nature's Grasp massive root wave. E sapling bush traps. Q knockback. W root dash. Passive AA heals. Zone control with saplings.
Q untargetable. R Highlander AS+MS+slow immune. BotRK+Guinsoo double proc. Late-game 1v9.
Long-range poke mage. Horizon Focus reveals + bonus damage on long-range hits. Comet guaranteed on CC. Zone control and siege.
R Breath of Life = AoE cleanse ALL allies of CC + heal. Passive Fired Up empowers ally AAs. E shield. Q fireball poke. THE anti-CC enchanter.
Passive Love Tap bonus damage on new targets. Q bounce doubles damage on kill. E slow zone. R Bullet Time channel massive AoE. Best with AoE CC setup (Amumu R, Leona R).
Passive AoE damage aura. Q isolated bonus damage. W shield/heal. E pull. R Realm of Death = 1v1 arena stealing 10% enemy stats. Riftmaker true damage + Conqueror drain. Rylai perma-slow on passive.
Q Dark Binding 2-3s root. E Black Shield blocks CC on ally. W tormented soil zone. R Soul Shackles stun if tethered. E counters hook supports (Blitzcrank, Thresh, Nautilus). THE anti-engage support.
W bounce heals+damages. E empowers ally AAs. Q bubble stun. R tidal wave. Best all-around enchanter.
Farm Q stacks permanently. Divine Sunderer %HP on Q. W wither. R stat boost. Demolish+TP split push. Infinite scaling.
Q hook. Passive root. R unstoppable knockup. THE most CC-heavy support. Hexflash for angles.
Human Q spear = long-range poke (marks Hunted). Cougar form Q execute on Hunted. W trap/pounce. E heal (human) or swipe (cougar). Transform jungler. High skill ceiling.
Passive bonus XP sharing. W dodge zone. Q slash. R Apotheosis AoE burst + heal. Melee ADC that needs engage support (Leona, Nautilus).
R Paranoia = global darkness + long-range dash to target. Hexplate AS+MS after R. Q trail AD bonus. W spell shield. E fear tether. Dive backline from anywhere.
Portal-based mage. Place portals for map mobility. Poke and zone control with abilities. Enchanter hybrid for mid/support.
W Biggest Snowball Ever = rolling engage. Q Consume heals + objective secure. E root on 3 stacks. R Absolute Zero massive AoE channel. Fast clear, strong ganks, objective control.
R Ragnarok = CC immune. Passive AS scales with missing HP. Low HP = maximum DPS. Last Stand synergy. Run at carries with R active.
Ball on engage ally then R Shockwave for AoE pull. Q+W poke. E shield ally. THE team fight mage.
R ram summon + redirect for AoE knockup. W brittle + E dash knockup. Passive upgrades ally items at 14. THE scaling tank.
W empowered stun + Q empowered thrust. E shield blocks all frontal damage. R semi-global dive. Dominate early, fall off late.
W blocks enemy dashes. E wall stun. R channel massive knockback. Counter pick vs Camille, Irelia, Lee Sin.
Q hook + E stun + R X-shape execute. R resets on kill + shares gold. W stealth + HP regen. THE assassin support.
R+Flash AoE charm then W knockup. E dash to ally for escape. Guardian shield on ally. Xayah synergy bonus.
Q Powerball engage. E taunt forces AAs. W bonus armor + reflect. Passive AD from armor. THE anti-AD tank. Counter vs full AD teams.
W dismount crash + R Magnet Storm AoE pull. Passive steals armor/MR. E stun tether with ally. Heavy engage support.
Fury W empowered stun burst. E in + W + Q + E out trade pattern. R Dominus HP + fury gen + AoE. Dominate lane, fall off late.
R stealth reveal nearest enemy + guaranteed crit leap. Bush leap + full ferocity combo = one-shot. THE stealth assassin.
Fast Q combo (Q+AA weave). E+R1 for shield+AD. Flash+W stun. R2 Wind Slash execute. Shy Combo (E+R1+Flash+W+AA+R2+Q). Highest skill ceiling champion.
Heat system: 50+ heat = empowered abilities. Overheat = bonus AA damage but silenced. Q Flamespitter AoE burn. R The Equalizer = line of fire for massive AoE. Best ult for objective fights.
EQ spread combo for AoE. Phase Rush proc for kiting. RoA + Archangel mana scaling. R Realm Warp teleports team. Double mana scaling. Late-game machine gun mage.
Style rank E→S from unique hits. At S rank: R Inferno Trigger AoE spin. BT lifesteal during R. W blocks projectiles. Best with hard engage supports.
Passive souls grant AD+range+crit infinitely. Q heal+poke. W root. E team stealth. R global shield+damage beam. Infinite scaling support.
Every 3rd ability echoes (double cast). R extending charm through allies. W shield+heal. Q poke.
E pull enemies together. W Haymaker stores grit = true damage center. R grab enemy tank + slam into their team. Simple but devastating.
R Stand United = global shield on ally + teleport. Q Spirit Blade empowers AAs. W dodge zone. E taunt dash. Split push then R to team fights.
R Dragon's Descent transform = empowered abilities. E fireball (dragon form) = massive AoE burst. Passive bonus dragon stats. W burnout MS + AoE. Dragon control specialist.
Q poison trail while running. W glue slow. E fling over shoulder. R Insanity Potion massive stat boost. Ghost + Phase Rush + Rylai = perma-slow while unkillable.
W passive permanent HP from minion kills. Heartsteel + Grasp + Overgrowth = triple HP stacking. Titanic scales with HP. Q charged knockup. R Unstoppable Onslaught charge. Passive zombie on death.
W Ricochet bouncing AAs for wave clear + team fight AoE. E spell shield blocks one ability. Q boomerang poke. R On the Hunt team MS buff. Caster ADC with utility.
Passive Q kills stack permanently. At 25/125/225 stacks Q upgrades. R MMOOOMMMM = mom dragon AoE fire breath. Farm Q stacks safely. Late-game monster with max stacks.

Q Hymn of Valor poke + Aery. W Aria of Perseverance heal + shield. E Song of Celerity MS boost. R Crescendo AoE stun. Passive Power Chord empowered AA every 3 casts (Q=damage, W=damage reduction, E=slow). Ardent+Staff on every heal/shield. THE aura enchanter.
W heal allies (costs HP). Q heals self. E silence zone. R Wish global heal all allies. Warmog regen between fights to refill HP spent on W. THE healer.
Passive pull CC'd enemies. E root. W long-range vision. R Demonic Ascension drain AoE + heal. R2 burst. Rylai perma-slow on R drain.
Q sphere spam. E push spheres for stun. W grab+throw. R Unleashed Power hurls ALL spheres at target. More spheres = more damage. Abilities upgrade at max rank.
E vault over terrain for fastest roams. Passive 3 hits = bleed. W rake + return. Q melee crit on wounded. R Shadow Assault blade ring + stealth. Roam assassin.
Q blind negates AA champions. E poison on-hit. R Noxious Trap invisible mushroom mines. Nashor on-hit + E poison = sustained poke. Mushroom map control.
Q hook + dash to target. W Lantern saves allies. E Flay knockback. R The Box slow walls. Souls grant permanent armor+AP. Most versatile support.
Passive range increases per level (longest late). E bomb detonation on 4 AAs. W jump reset on kills. R Buster Shot self-peel knockback.
R Undying Rage = CANNOT die for 5s. Fury = free crit chance. E spin dash. Split push towers. Last Stand + low HP = maximum damage during R.
W gold card stun + Lich Bane Spellblade = burst. R Destiny reveals all + teleport for global ganks. First Strike gold gen from fog. THE roaming mid.
Q stealth approach. R Spray and Pray = bonus range + piercing AAs. Hurricane bolts + piercing R = team-wiping AoE. E Expunge stacks for burst. Late-game hypercarry from stealth.

Passive shotgun knees deal %HP per direction. W toggles shield + rapid fire. E flip + stun on terrain. R Fear Beyond Death drills then executes below 25% HP. Walk around enemies to proc all 6 knee shotguns.
W Blight stacks = %HP pop on ability hit. AA 3x then Q or E to pop stacks. Guinsoo double proc on-hit. R Chain of Corruption root spreads to nearby enemies. On-hit shreds tanks.
W Silver Bolts %HP true damage every 3rd AA. Guinsoo double proc = more W procs. Q tumble + R stealth. E Condemn wall stun. THE anti-tank hypercarry.
Passive Q kills + ability hits = permanent AP stacking. E cage stun zone. R Primordial Burst scales with enemy missing HP + your AP. Infinite scaling. Late-game R one-shots anyone.
Passive 3 ability hits = true damage proc. Q geometry poke. W zone. E knockup. R Disintegration Ray channel = massive sustained damage. Comet + slow guarantees hit.
Passive fears enemies who dash near Vex. W AoE fear + shield. Q long-range poke. E AoE slow. R Shadow Surge long-range dash to enemy, recast on hit. THE anti-mobility mage.
Q charge dash + knockback. W armor shred passive. E AoE cone after AA. R Assault and Battery = unstoppable suppress + knockup on target. Flash+R for surprise lockdown on backline carry.
Passive possess killed enemies using their kit + items. Q double AA. W charge stun. E mist zone camouflage + AS. R Heartbreaker blink to enemy for AoE execute. Chain resets via possession.
Hex Core upgrades abilities with gold. E laser is primary poke + wave clear. Upgraded E aftershock. W gravity field stun. R Chaos Storm persistent AoE. Late-game machine gun mage.
Passive HP to AP and AP to HP conversion. Q sustain poke (empowered 3rd Q). W Sanguine Pool untargetable. E charge AoE. R Hemoplague AoE damage amplify then burst. Flash+R+E+Q+W = team fight bomb.
Passive chain lightning at max stacks. Q MS + stun on AA. W bite heal. E AoE shield + slow zone. R Stormbringer = leap + disable turret + gain HP. Tower dive specialist.

Passive on-hit magic damage + heal below 50% HP. Q hold follows dashes. W blood hunt MS toward low-HP enemies. E damage reduction + AoE fear. R Infinite Duress long-range suppress. Beginner-friendly jungler.
Passive bonus resists near enemies. Q armor shred. W clone decoy + dash. E dash + AS boost. R Cyclone = 2x AoE spin + knockup. Can cast R twice. E+R into enemy team = game-winning.

Passive: abilities make AAs leave feathers. E Bladecaller recalls ALL feathers = root enemies hit by 3+. W AS boost + Rakan synergy. R Featherstorm = untargetable + rain feathers. E after R = guaranteed root.

Passive heals every 3rd AA. Q 3 empowered AAs (3rd knocks up). W slash + thrust. E dash + slow. R Crescent Guard knockback ALL except last hit target + blocks ranged from outside. Isolate carry with R.
Double crit passive = 100% crit with 2 crit items. Q tornado knockup. W Windwall blocks projectiles. E dash through minions. R Last Breath on airborne targets. Best with knockup allies.
Double crit passive. E spirit form = bonus damage stored. Q3 knockup. W spirit blade shield. R Fate Sealed long dash AoE knockup. E trade then snap back to safety.

W attach to ally = untargetable. Q guided missile poke. E heal + MS on attached ally. R Final Chapter 3 waves of CC. Attach to carry, buff with Ardent/Staff, heal with E, poke with Q. Never detach in fights.
R Death Mark dash to target + mark pops for % of damage dealt. W shadow clone + Q double shuriken. E AoE slow. R swap back to safety. THE AD mid assassin.
Q is her basic attack (skillshot). R Lightning Crash AoE + massive MS + Q becomes piercing. E wall dash. Trinity Spellblade on Q spam. Most mobile ADC.
Q Bouncing Bomb long-range poke. W Satchel Charge knockback + tower execute. E Minefield zone control. R Mega Inferno Bomb massive global AoE. Comet + slow guarantees hit. THE siege mage.

Q Time Bomb AoE stun (double bomb). W Rewind reduces all CDs. E massive MS boost/slow on ally/enemy. R Chronoshift = REVIVE ally on death. THE utility support. Double bomb stun + R revive wins team fights.
E Sleep bubble + max-range Q redirect = one-shot from fog. R Portal Jump extends Q range. W picks up enemy summoner spells/actives. Long-range poke assassin.
Passive seeds spawn. Q/E on seeds = plants. Q ranged plant poke. E root vine + melee plant. R Stranglethorns AoE knockup. Rylai perma-slow on plant AAs. Zone control mage support.
